messages:
maria: Quick sync — hydration/orchestration contracts for sharded safetensors. We have three open q's: (1) Manifest vs index-first semantics, (2) who retries/backs off on partial shard reads, (3) fallback ordering when some shards are missing. Need a short owner split so we can add tests and telemetry. :eyes:

jon: Manifest vs index-first — are we standardizing on a single canonical manifest schema or allowing both? I prefer a single manifest to avoid double-negotiation.

kevin: Single manifest makes sense. Proposal: manifest is authoritative for layout + compression + checksums. Loader contract: `fetch_shard(shard_id) -> Stream[bytes] | Err` and `verify_shard(stream, checksum)`. Orchestrator handles ordering, timeouts, and can ask loader for partial ranges.

sophia: Agreed. Also we need clear telemetry points: warmup_start, shard_received, verification_failed, fallthrough_triggered. These should be emitted by loader and annotated by orchestrator with request_id.

alan: On fallback ordering — prefer regional-local -> cached-prefix -> remote. Also suggest TTLs for warm shards and eviction-priority hints in the manifest: `priority_hint: hot|warm|cold`.

jon: Who owns retries? loader or orchestrator? If loader retries, it needs to be idempotent and expose retry_count. If orchestrator retries it can try alternate shards/providers.

maria: My take: loader owns low-level IO retries (socket/connect/backoff) with capped attempts and exposes `retry_count` + transient error types. Orchestrator owns semantic retries (switch provider, fall back to quantized variant, or route to hosted). Keeps complexity out of loader.

kevin: Sounds good. Small API sketch:

```
# loader
fetch_shard(shard_id, byte_range=None, deadline_ms=None) -> {stream_uri, bytes_read, retry_count, checksum_ok}

# orchestrator
request_weights(model_id, shards_list, deadline_ms) -> success | partial_failure | fallback_plan
```

sophia: For partial shards we should support range checksums (per-chunk crc) so we can stream-verify and avoid big re-downloads. Also manifest should include `chunk_size` and `chunk_checksums`.

deploy-bot: ci:eng-ml/weights-loader-tests passed — 14/14 :white_check_mark:

maria: Great. Action items: kevin will draft RFC follow-up with loader APIs + telemetry points, sophia will enumerate metrics/events and names, alan will prototype manifest `priority_hint` + chunk_checksums. I'll own doc linking to tests. Back on this thread next week. :thumbsup:
